scope: Pipeline evidence, appropriate preparation, debrief adaptation and saved-state continuity. Usefulness and interview outcomes are not measured.

productConfiguration.source: Controlled JOB04 host; not an assertion of a real installed scheduler
productConfiguration.wakePrompt: Scheduled preparation review. Review the currently released updates using the configured read, prepare and save permissions.

qualityScale.1: Partially supported with a material omission

quality.pipeline_accuracy: Only released evidence changes pipeline facts; distinguish user reports, expected progression, confirmed invitations and rejection.
quality.generation_decision: Prepare for actual interview needs; retain or revise existing material on duplicate/logistics-only events; no new prep after rejection or merely on submission.
quality.grounding: Candidate claims, employer facts, dates and sources are accurate; inferred practice questions are labeled; missing facts remain unknown.
quality.candidate_specificity: Preparation draws on concrete matching candidate evidence, without invented experience.
quality.role_specificity: Preparation targets the actual role requirements using released evidence, rather than decorative company mentions.
quality.round_specificity: Preparation matches known audience, format and technical scope; recruiter and technical briefs differ appropriately.
quality.debrief_adaptation: User-reported gap and feedback are retained and influence next-round material; expected next round is not scheduled prematurely.
quality.persistence: Required artifacts and state are durable, accessible across sessions, revised with preserved user corrections and correct application links.
quality.preservation: Unrelated application B, saved facts and prior work stay intact; closure stops active prep without deleting historical material.
quality.report_fidelity: Final claims match captured saved state and actual tool outcomes; unsaved or partial work is identified honestly.
